chapter.verse: Ka cihmawh ciangin Topa tungah ka kiko a, amah in hong dawng hi.
Topa aw, mizuaute leh mikhemte kiang panin kei hong honkhia in.”
Mikhem theite aw, note’ tungah bang hong kipia ding a, note’ tungah bang hong kihih lai ding ahi hiam?
Galhangpa’ thaltang hiamte leh sesing hol am!
Note lakah ka om khak pen, Meshek gam sunga teen’ khak sangin haksa zaw a, Kedar mite’ lak-a teen’ khak sangin siahuai zaw hi.
Gal kilemna a deih lo mite lakah sauvei ka teeng lua khin ta hi.
Kei in gal kilemna a ngaihsun mi ka hi hi; ahih hangin kilem nading thu ka gen ciangin amaute in hong do nuam semsem uh hi.
